texts: In the late summer of Year 1, one day before the autumn equinox, Meren Tallowhand walked to a station on the Cliff Path at sundown.
Meren Tallowhand lit the lantern at the station.
The lantern burned mire-essence.
The lantern produced mist-light.
The lantern showed mist-light at night.
The mist-light attracted nightmoths.
Meren Tallowhand tended the lantern that night.
Meren Tallowhand counted seventeen nightmoths at the lantern at the third watch.
A handful of nightmoths gathered at the Middle Row that night.
All the sky-cats stayed on the cliff-spires that night.

Stating the kind beside the name forces it: "A handful of nightmoths gathered at the row called the Middle Row that night."

Keepers counted seven of the nightmoths at the East Row at the third watch.
Some nightmoths survived the hunt.
The surviving nightmoths fled to the Hollows.
The surviving nightmoths reached the Hollows.
